## Superman SMES Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Simulated data for 47 participants rating Superman media on the
Subjective Media Experience Scale (SMES), grouped by the height gap
and age difference between the Superman and Lois Lane actors.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>superman_smes
</code></pre>


### Format

A data frame with 47 rows and 6 variables:


<dl>
<dt>num</dt><dd>Unique participant number
</dd>
<dt>height_gap</dt><dd>Height gap category: Minimal (1), Average (2), Big (3)
</dd>
<dt>age_grp</dt><dd>Age difference category: Minimal (1), Average (2), Big (3)
</dd>
<dt>emotional_impact</dt><dd>Emotional Impact subscale (sum of 4 items, range 4-20)
</dd>
<dt>aesthetic_appeal</dt><dd>Aesthetic Appeal subscale (sum of 3 items, range 3-15)
</dd>
<dt>cognitive_engagement</dt><dd>Cognitive Engagement subscale (mean of 4 items, range 0-7)
</dd>
</dl>
